text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O is talking to her reflection
in the
middle of dance practice.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Opera O of the mirror... How did
you achieve
such beauty?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Charms powerful enough to entice even
I, the
Centurial Overlord... Your
loveliness is terrifying!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
But I shall not give in! For I am destined
to stand
at the peak atop the mountain
path of
Overlordship!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Argh! You've yet to surrender, even
after our
arduous battle...

text_block_list.name: Dance Teacher
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O! Do I have to tell you
again? I'm
locking up the studio now!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
B-But! I have yet to resolve this epic
conflict!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Opera O is forced to prematurely
withdraw from
her battle, the shock of
which leaves her in a rut.
